liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): The intro to China Cat is noisy; China Cat into Rider features Pigpen on electric Wurlitzer, a rare appearance [9][10][18]
- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): The stretch from Dark Star through Not Fade Away is melodic and works as a true collective effort; Dark Star is short, roughly 13-14 minutes, but still nice [8][13][14]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Phil plays some unusual bass on Greatest Story [9]
- First played at this show; the band didn't play it again after 4/29/71 [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Equipment Checks/Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **Second That Emotion**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [19]
- **Equipment Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-04-08.sbd.deibert.83756.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 163 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Typical 1971 recording with hum and odd noises, and an imperfect mix, but cleaned up through technology; Minor flaws such as an occasional feedback squeak remain, adding a live feel; Hum and hum bursts from equipment problems that night, affecting Beat It On Down The Line and Goin' Down The Road [1][15][16]
- **gd1971-04-08.141099.sbd.betty.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 24 songs; 162 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Pops, clicks and ticks were cleaned up; right channel hum at spots was left as is [2]
- **gd1971-04-08.sbd.unknown.14397.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 155 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: A narrowband filter on the right channel reduced 60-cycle hum [3]
- **gd1971-04-08.sbd.lai.fix-120.23732.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 155 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Quite a few tape splice sounds are audible [4]
- **gd71-04-08.sbd.lai.120.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 155 min; rated 4.07/5 by 14 [5]. Said about its sound: Tape lacks low end when turned up loud; the cut in Second That Emotion does little harm; Quality is close to Skull and Roses, but volume often drops or vanishes briefly; editing could yield a 2-CD set; Dropouts occur in Loser, Second That Emotion and Dark Star, and levels bounce around too much [9][11][13]

## Around the show

- Attendee was at both Boston nights; the band seemed tired on April 7 but a bit rested on April 8 [17]
- The band had just played long shows in New York City before the two Boston nights [17]
- Tuning and banter between songs are left at the ends of tracks [1]
- Reviewer prefers fall 1971 Keith shows, but calls this the favorite of the two Boston Music Hall nights [10]
- Reviewer doubts this Dark Star beats the one from 4/28 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-04-08.sbd.deibert.83756.sbeok.flac16**: source: 7" Betty Board Reel > PCM501ES analog out > Dolby A Decoder > Analog in PCMF1 PCM501ES analog out > Fostex D5 optical S/PDIF out > disk [1]. Also: Tim Diebert's work made this version available; Made from wavs Tim backed up from his 2002 transfer, SBE-fixed by set and encoded to flac16 [1][15]
- **gd1971-04-08.141099.sbd.betty.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Betty Cantor and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Betty's 7" two track reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM (Sony L-750ESX-HFB tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro… [2]
- **gd1971-04-08.sbd.unknown.14397.shnf**: transferred by theotherwayne; source: SMR>PCM>WAV>Shn [3]. Also: Converted with Prodif96Pro and edited in Samplitude [3]
- **gd1971-04-08.sbd.lai.fix-120.23732.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by sbe fix; source: Sound Board [4]. Also: Shntool fixed the SBEs with each set in a separate directory; new seek tables and md5 added in 2004 [4]
- **gd71-04-08.sbd.lai.120.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: Soundboard [5]
